operationMembers.trigger: X7e submit action or guarded rut submit/steer/queue intent, through Qft and the selected existing-local branch.

retainedGuards.claim: X7e creates the submit action using Jx and onClick closure ()=>void B(), where B is handleSubmit. Disabled/interactions, voice state and submitButtonMode guard the action. Qft supplies handleSubmit as options=>Xl({...options,focusComposerAfterSubmit:true}). This is a React factory callback property, not evidence of a rendered click or DOM dispatch.

rpt selects rZ for scope.kind local, otherwise Qft. The complete original initializer assigns rZ=wp(async loader) whose returned function emits Qft({...props,queuedMessageList}); load error propagation is configured. Successful lazy load/render and selected scope remain runtime unknown.

rut registers composer.submit through actual QS and a body Enter handler. It rejects prevented/composing/key229/modifier/repeat paths and applies editor focus/code-block and configured Cmd/Enter behavior. Static handler registration does not prove an event was received.

rut ordinary submit callback checks interactions and resumePending, handles dictation stop separately, respects submitDisabled, optionally consumes queued steer, and only submit mode invokes submit({focusComposerAfterSubmit:true,onSubmitted:context?.onComposerSubmitted}); stop mode breaks.

Qft Xl calls Mc directly or adds navigation background, and the Mc local is destructured as submitComposer from the exact Zut call. Qft gives Xl to rut and X7e; this joins actual local declarations and callback properties rather than spelling.

Qft Cdt receives local.submit:F and worktree.submit:V from onSubmitLocal/onSubmitWorktree props. Cdt builds distinct local/worktree/cloud targets and wraps local context and policy validation before forwarding local.submit(context,...remainingArgs).

rpt takes handleSubmitLocal:xn, handleNewWorktreeConversation:bn and queuedFollowUpSubmission:Sn from _9e result, then supplies onSubmitLocal:xn/onSubmitWorktree:bn/onStop:Gn/isStopping:Kn to its Qft or rZ view. Compiler memoization preserves local assignment shape; actual cache branch execution is unobserved.

Put collects editor text/persistedText, mentions and attachments; it rejects empty or blocked/stale submission paths, prepares context and references, and switches targets by kind. Its local.submit argument positions carry context,cwd,execution options,restore message,client message ID,queue overrides and onMessageAdded.

Put uses onMessageAdded locallyAccepted/requestDispatched to release UI submission state and clear or retain draft/history; submitted/queued results have their own callbacks. It does not treat these UI callbacks as turn/completed notifications.

Put distinguishes queued/sent, first-turn creation-outcome-unknown/rejected/not-started and delivery-not-sent/outcome-unknown. AbortError bypasses ordinary reporting; finally and restore/retain callbacks follow ownership/current-submission checks. No persisted turn result is inferred from editor clearing.

_9e existing-local branch vAe is source-qualified initial.jvt=Tta. It passes scope,targetConversationId,managerHostId/hostId,context,cwd,mode/permission/service tier,restore/client message,callbacks and prepareContext; durable scoped admission can instead take dRe branch. The actual selected branch is unknown.
Tta jg imports shared.y$t whose exported local is KI; primary zg imports the same source-qualified export. Initial zg and generic shared.x$t/GI are distinct and are not manager accessor evidence.

Tta verifies submission current/abort, loads conversation state, builds restored user message and execution/permission/context options, obtains getTurnCoordinator(), and calls sendMessage with queueOptions,acceptLocally,preparation,onMessageAdded,preflight/assertAdmission. Actual injected scope/client data are unobserved.

Tta installs a local message-added observer and unavailable/error watcher only when conditions require it, awaits the displayed acceptance promise and removes watchers in finally. This is acceptance/display coordination, not proof of completed-turn persistence.

retainedGuards.claim: X7e uses a distinct stop action when buttonMode is stop and Aeon conditions allow it; its callback calls onStop I and its disabled/loading fields use isStopping/interactions. Resume and voice-stop actions use separate callbacks and are not ordinary turn interruption.

xQe maintains confirmation for current turnId; handleStop clears the confirmation store then calls its onStop. Qft wires that callback to parent H(Yo??undefined) and supplies handleStop to X7e. This is confirmation state, not RPC success or cancellation receipt.

rpt Cn chooses local override/follow-up conversation, deduplicates IDs in a Set, sets stopping UI state, awaits _Oe with conversationId/hostId/initiatedBy:user then removes state in finally; cloud uses another mutation/state. This ordinary composer callback does not pass expectedTurnId; Qft confirmation turnId does not bind wire expectedTurnId. Gn catches local stop failures for interruptThreadError toast, with its distinct cloud rethrow path.

primary _Oe imports initial.gmt=yda. yda uses provided client or KI(scope,host/thread host) then interruptConversation(thread,user-stop/system,expectedTurnId); only for initiatedBy user, a non-null result or error.interruptedTurnId updates local interruption result before error rethrow. System initiation does not perform that local update. It does not call stopThread on the ordinary path.

Dfn interruptConversationSelf first requests follower owner interruption; only follower timeout/version-mismatch/no-client-found marks resume and falls back local. Local Ien receives runtime cleanup, state update and sendInterruptRequest turn/interrupt callback; explicit expectedTurnId bypasses goal pause. System/user/descendant modes have distinct goal pause order and user 500ms critical timeout; goal pause failure can attach interruptedTurnId after interruption.

Dfn interruptConversation finally conditionally interrupts descendants unless descendant-cleanup/follower; user-stop uses background cleanup, other modes await it. Completion of the parent UI promise is not a claim that all descendants or notification reducers have completed.

Dfn.sendRequest asserts manager active and awaits injected requestClient.sendRequest(method,params,options); it is a static transport delegation. Actual preload/main/native receiver and persisted effects for this UI invocation remain unjoined.
